subject: Partner consignment: activation plan for SI PoC credit pool
messages:
From: Sara Malik <sara@cloudway.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: consigning a partner credit pool for SI-led PoC

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As discussed, CloudWay would like to consign a pool of promotional credits on Redwood's marketplace to support an SI-led proof-of-concept with three joint customers (expected start: 2027-12-05). High-level ask: a 50k token-equivalent credit pool, valid for 30 days from activation, with per-tenant caps and basic usage guardrails.

Attached is a brief proposal with allocation suggestions and the activation flow we use for marketplace consignment. Key asks/questions:
- Can Redwood enable a marketplace-labeled credit pool tied to CloudWay's listing?
- Will you support activation on a per-tenant basis (we'll provide tenant IDs)?
- Who needs to sign the consignment agreement on Redwood's side?

If it helps, we can start with a smaller pilot tranche and top-up based on usage. We're hoping for a quick turnaround so the SI can schedule onboarding next week.

Thanks,
Sara Malik
Head of Partnerships, CloudWay Solutions
[sent from mobile]

[Attachment: CloudWay_Partner_Consignment_Proposal.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara@cloudway.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-28T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: consigning a partner credit pool for SI-led PoC

Sara —

Appreciate the clear ask and the proposal doc. Quick answers and next steps from Redwood:

- We can support a marketplace-labeled consignment. We need the CloudWay marketplace ID and the SI customer tenant IDs before activation.
- For initial approval, finance + partner ops sign-off is required; I'll loop in Aditya and Laura to run approvals and confirm budget code.
- We prefer to start with a pilot tranche (e.g., 25k credits) and then top-up if utilization looks healthy. If you need the full 50k upfront, we'll need an associated co-marketing commitment and a signed consignment agreement.

Please confirm which approach you prefer. If you're okay with the pilot tranche, we'll prepare an activation sheet and a short consignment agreement for signature. Can you also share the marketplace listing URL?

I'll propose internal approvers and timeline once I have the marketplace ID.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Malik <sara@cloudway.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: consigning a partner credit pool for SI-led PoC

Looping in a couple of notes from GTM/Finance perspective:

- Deal reference: DEAL-9485. Suggest starting with 30k credits (split across 3 tenants = 10k each) for the initial 30-day PoC. If we see >=60% utilization by day 20, we can auto-release an additional 20k.
- We need an activation spreadsheet populated with tenant IDs + expected start dates. I've attached a template (consignment_activation_sheet.xlsx).
- Please confirm per-tenant spend caps and that the credit usage will be restricted to Redwood-hosted inference (to avoid misuse).

Action items for Redwood:
- Finance to create a short consignment amendment (1 page) for signature.
- Partner ops to confirm marketplace labelling and activation flow.

Sara — can you confirm the marketplace URL and whether CloudWay requires the credits to be visible as a line item in the portal or fully-managed by CloudWay?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: consignment_activation_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Malik <sara@cloudway.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: consigning a partner credit pool for SI-led PoC

Thanks team — a few practical constraints from ops/marketing:

- Marketing would prefer there be a co-marketing plan attached if we approve >30k credits upfront. We can still support SI enablement for a smaller pilot but need a joint announcement and case study plan for anything larger.
- Finance is OK with a pilot of 30k but requires a PO or signed consignment form with explicit top-up terms.
- Partner ops note: please ensure CloudWay understands that tenant-level IDs must be provided in the activation sheet 48 hours before the scheduled start to allow routing and entitlement provisioning.

Proposed compromise: approve 30k initial consignment (10k per tenant). CloudWay to provide tenant IDs by 2027-12-03 17:00 PT. We will prepare the consignment agreement and have legal review it. If CloudWay wants the full 50k now, we will need a co-marketing commitment + signed SOW.

Laura Bennett
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Malik <sara@cloudway.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-02T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: consigning a partner credit pool for SI-led PoC

Thanks — that sounds workable. We can proceed with the 30k pilot (10k per tenant) and will provide the three tenant IDs by EOD 2027-12-03. We also agree to the 48-hour activation window.

Attached: signed consignment request (signed_consignment_agreement.pdf) and a filled activation sheet (consignment_activation_sheet.xlsx) with placeholder tenant IDs (will replace with final values). Once Redwood confirms the marketplace label and activation link, we'll schedule SI onboarding for 2027-12-06.

Next steps (per our internal checklist):
- Redwood: confirm marketplace ID and provide activation link + final consignment agreement for signature (if you need additional signature fields).
- CloudWay: send final tenant IDs by 2027-12-03 17:00 PT.
- Joint: schedule 30-minute activation call for 2027-12-05 to validate entitlements.

Speak soon,
Sara Malik
Head of Partnerships, CloudWay Solutions

[Attachment: signed_consignment_agreement.pdf (pdf)]
